sourcePolicy.transportMirror: AISHELL/AISHELL-4 at pinned Hugging Face revision; namespace ownership alone is not used as provenance proof.
sourcePolicy.originalLicenseRetained: OpenSLR declares CC BY-SA4.0. Mirror card says Apache2.0; that difference is recorded and not treated as proof of relicensing.
sourcePolicy.sourceValidation: Selected TextGrids compare with official OpenSLR training archive annotation text, ignoring only CRLF/LF transport differences; original official bytes are kept and both hashes recorded. The first selected FLAC size equals the official tar member. Byte-range payloads remain pinned to mirror revision/LFS expected whole-file SHA; a partially read file is not claimed whole-file SHA verified.
sourcePolicy.split: Two distinct training sessions/room tags from the published train_L subset; one train_S session reserved for adaptation validation. Do not claim complete physical-speaker independence from tier labels. Paper reports no train/test room overlap but one shared participant. Current exposed L/S/AMI and final heldout meeting are excluded from all training sources.

dataSelection.selection: 4s original mono-channel-zero excerpts;8examples/category/meeting, round-robin speakers after deterministic within-speaker shuffle. Categories absent(other speech>=1s), short(target<=2s and contained0.15-2s utterance), overlap(any target/other overlap), solo(target>=1s). All are original recorded mixtures, no artificial speech mixing or denoising.
dataSelection.enrollment: Longest annotated target-only span outside every selected query window in that same session, center<=10s with60ms boundary guards,>=3s. Supervision is allowed only for training/adaptation-validation construction. Previous67-query deployment controls keep their original automatic profiles.
dataSelection.labels: 25native160ms grid cells per4s; any lexical target activity in a cell is1. Same source annotation/normalization conventions retained. Labels are supervised training truth, never supplied to deployment inference.
dataSelection.notGeneralizationProof: Small supervised pilot, two large-room training tags and a distinct small-room session for validation. Physical speaker independence is not established; published train/eval has one shared participant. Original exposed development recordings and final holdout remain excluded from training.
dataSelection.plannedRun: First verify identical eval outputs, frozen weights, nonzero finite head gradients and bounded resources on real training examples; no synthetic accuracy claims. Only then one frozen training run. Do not select epochs or thresholds on the prior13development controls.

decision.actualChange: Implemented a trainable, byte-verified frozen-backbone adaptation path on the existing released target-activity model; actually trained two finite3epoch controls on additional real meetings. No new ASR/separation/backend default.
decision.decision: Neither adaptation meets the unchanged cross-meeting activity criteria. Retain the existing NativeFP16 research baseline; do not install either head, expand it to full ASR/separation, add epochs, sweep cutoffs or call loss reduction a product gain.

comparison.unit: Sum of target-wise missed plus false activity seconds over the same13original30s clips/67queries. Simultaneous targets are counted separately. Not wordCER, standardDER, final<5% or minutes accuracy.

interpretation: First adaptation increased recall but also false acceptance; lower separate-room cross_entropy did not predict successful attribution on the existing real deployment controls.

All-profile supervision on identical mixtures reduced erroneous activity versus both target-activity predecessors, but missed short and overlapped target speech and remained worse than the existing native baseline.
This is evidence against promoting this finite small-head recipe; it does not isolate data scale, acoustic representation, profile quality and architecture as a single proven root cause.

technicalFailureBeforeAnyPairedTrainingU.reason: Create the omitted cache parent before the first training update. No model/labels/seed/hyperparameters/threshold changes; no automatic quality-failure retry.
